proposals.finding: Position continuity and decision marks are confirmed only through 2026-07-24.
proposals.proposal: Require fresh completed-close marks and explicit user zero-Delta or transaction Delta before any live action or period attribution.
proposals.title: Current-state and completed-close gate

proposals.finding: Simulation open P&L ¥16,388.90 differs from account P&L ¥7,938.48 by ¥-8,450.42.
proposals.proposal: Every review must bridge open unrealized P&L to account P&L through realized, fee and other ledger effects; never force equality.
proposals.title: Simulation P&L bridge is mandatory

proposals.finding: Current mark-to-recorded-cost figures lack a complete period-start baseline and external-flow reconciliation.
proposals.proposal: Label snapshot contribution separately and block monthly or annual return claims until a reconciled period ledger exists.
proposals.title: Snapshot contribution is not period return

proposals.finding: All Simulation sleeves remain inside R2 bands while growth innovation and CSI500 are the principal negative contributors.
proposals.proposal: Review security selection and entry quality inside a sleeve before changing the entire sleeve architecture.
proposals.title: Diagnose sleeve internals before portfolio overhaul

proposals.finding: Growth names with weak contribution remain subject to R3 evidence and valuation gates.
proposals.proposal: Do not add merely because a position is below cost; require thesis, cash-flow, valuation and portfolio-fit evidence.
proposals.title: No-add and hard-review controls remain binding

proposals.finding: Candidate has two valid entry baselines but zero completed 20/60/120-day windows.
proposals.proposal: Keep Alpha claims blocked and preserve Candidate membership until governed windows mature and reconcile to benchmarks.
proposals.title: Candidate Alpha claims require mature windows

proposals.finding: Real account execution cash is only ¥120.49 and external liquidity is managed outside the securities account.
proposals.proposal: Exclude external liquidity from allocation and do not create a fixed strategic cash target for the Real account.
proposals.title: Real-account cash remains execution balance

proposals.finding: Current conclusions are dominated by one accepted watermark and incomplete prospective outcome windows.
proposals.proposal: Require repeated observations, failure classification, regression tests and explicit user approval before applying a rule change.
proposals.title: No single snapshot may mutate strategy rules
